title: Reverted "Fixed relative paths imports per isort 4.3.5."
body:
This reverts commit 463fe11bc8b2d068e447c5df677e7a31c2af7e03 due to restore of relative paths sorting from `isort` < 4.3.5 in `isort` [4.3.10](https://github.com/timothycrosley/isort/releases/tag/4.3.10).

Alternatively we can add `-rr` to reverse the order of relative path imports (see 
https://github.com/jpgrayson/isort/commit/e60c651a3e7847f406c0ee8a8eb36c96bfe24cb7 and https://github.com/timothycrosley/isort/issues/417). I would prefer to restore the previous order because it seems more correct to sort from the least local  import.

title: Fixed relative paths imports per isort 4.3.5.
